messages.subject: Re: writeVector issue
parts:
Hi Ollie,

I would try ctmm::writeVector if loading terra caused R to get confused.

Best,
Chris

On Tuesday, September 5, 2023 at 5:21:26 PM UTC-4 ollie....@gmail.com wrote:
Hey Chris - can you help trouble shoot the following error message when attempting to apply the writeVector function to an akde:  Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable) : unable to find an inherited method for function ‘writeVector’ for signature ‘"UD", "character"’

Code:

for (i in unique(gps.data$id.hd.sn)) {
 
  cat("Filtering data for", i,  " ")
 
  df_filtered <- gps.data |>
    filter(id.hd.sn == i) |>
    select(individual.local.identifier, location.lat, location.long, timestamp, dop)
 
  cat("Creating telemetry objects for", i," ")
 
  suppressMessages(
    df_as_telem <- df_filtered |>
      as.telemetry()
  )
 
  projection(df_as_telem) <- median(df_as_telem)
 
  cat("Creating FITS for", i," ")

     
  GUESS <- ctmm.guess(df_as_telem, interactive = FALSE)
  FITS <- ctmm.select(df_as_telem, GUESS, trace = 3)
 
  # Create akdes UD
  #grid=list(dr=1000^2,align.to.origin=TRUE)) = 1000m grid size
  cat("Creating akdes for", i," ")
 
  akdes <- akde(df_as_telem, FITS)
 

  # Save the akde metadata as .rds
  filename1 <- paste("C:/Users/ollie/OneDrive/Desktop/NMC MSc/!Research/Caribou Distribution/Results/Preliminary/KDE/metadata/metadata_",
                     i, ".rds", sep = "")
  
write_rds(akdes, filename1)
 
  # Create the plot
  cat("Creating plots for", i," ")
 
  col <- color(akdes, by = 'individual')
 
  # Write the plot to the local computer with a unique name
  filename2 <- paste("C:/Users/ollie/OneDrive/Desktop/NMC MSc/!Research/Caribou Distribution/Results/Preliminary/KDE/plots/plot_",
                     i, ".png", sep = "")
  png(filename2)
  plot(df_as_telem, akdes, col = col, error = TRUE)
  dev.off()
 
  cat( i, "complete", " ")
 
  #Create shapefiles
  cat("Creating shapefiles for", i," ")

  # Write the shapefile to the local computer with a unique name
  filename3 <- paste("C:/Users/ollie/OneDrive/Desktop/NMC MSc/!Research/Caribou Distribution/Results/Preliminary/KDE/shapefile/shp_",
                      i,
                     ".gpkg",
                     sep = "")
  writeVector(x = akdes, filename = filename3, filetype="ESRI Shapefile", convex=FALSE, level.UD=0.95,level=0.95)

}
